title: Adobe Express for Social and Marketing Teams
subtitle: One day on Adobe Express for teams who have to publish something every week, on brand
summary: One day on Adobe Express: brand kits, locked templates, a resized campaign set, animation and short video, review and export, with ACP exam practice.
description_html:
Most marketing teams do not have a design bottleneck. They have a consistency problem. Five people make posts in five tools, the logo is a slightly different blue in each one, and the designer spends Friday afternoon fixing captions in files she did not make. Adobe Express is built for exactly that situation, and this course is about setting it up so the team can move quickly without the brand drifting.

You start by drawing the line: what belongs in Express, and what still belongs in Photoshop or InDesign. Then you build the thing that makes everything else work, a brand kit holding your logos, colours and fonts, and apply it to a template so a colleague gets the right blue without being asked. You build a locked template where the headline and image can be changed but the logo, margins and colours cannot, which is the single change that saves most teams the most time.

The afternoon is production. You take one campaign design and produce it as a feed post, a story and a web banner without rebuilding it, use quick actions to remove a background and clean up a supplied photograph, add a generated image and a text treatment through the Firefly features built into Express, animate a static post, and cut a twenty second vertical video with trimmed clips, music at a sensible level and captions that are readable with the sound off. You finish with the team workflow: shared libraries, comments and approval, the scheduling tools where your plan includes them, and a print-ready PDF export for a flyer going to a printer in Colombo.

Content is mapped to the domains of the Adobe Certified Professional in Adobe Express exam, delivered by Certiport at authorised test centres, and the day ends with a timed practice task in the same shape. MyLearnPlus does not award the Adobe credential and no course can guarantee a pass.

The class runs live online in your own timezone or in the classroom in Colombo, priced in LKR for learners in Sri Lanka and USD for everyone else. Teams can be invoiced, and the same day can be run privately using your own brand assets, so you leave with your real brand kit and templates built rather than a practice set.
certification_alignment: Prepares for the Adobe Certified Professional in Adobe Express exam
outcomes: Set up a brand kit holding your logos, colour palette and fonts, and apply it to a template in one step.
Judge which jobs belong in Express and which still need Photoshop, Illustrator or InDesign, and move a file between them.
Build a locked template where colleagues can change the headline and image but not the logo, margins or colours.
Produce one campaign design as a feed post, a story and a web banner using resize, without rebuilding the layout.
Clean up a supplied photograph with quick actions, including removing a background and cropping to a required shape.
Generate an image and a text treatment with the Firefly features built into Express, and check the Content Credentials on the result.
Animate a static post and export it as a short looping file suited to a social feed.
Cut a twenty second vertical video with trimmed clips, a music bed at a sensible level and readable captions.
Run a review cycle using shared libraries, comments and approval so a post is signed off before it is published.
Export the right file for each destination, including a print-ready PDF for a flyer and correctly sized files for each social platform.
prerequisites: No prior design experience is needed, and no previous Adobe software experience is assumed.
You should be comfortable with your own computer and with working in a browser.
Bring your logo files, brand colours and fonts if you have them, so the exercises use your own material.
audiences: Social media managers and content coordinators publishing several posts a week
Marketing executives in small teams with no in-house designer
Internal communications and HR staff producing announcements, posters and slide graphics
Small business owners and online sellers running their own social channels
Designers who need to hand safe, locked templates to non-designer colleagues

faqs.question: Do I need my own laptop?
faqs.answer: Yes, for live online and for the classroom in Colombo, so the brand kit and templates you build stay in your own account and are usable on Monday. Express runs in a browser, so the machine does not need to be powerful, but a stable connection matters because the files live in the cloud. Bring your logo, fonts and brand colours if you have them.

faqs.question: Is Adobe Express free, or do I need to pay for it?
faqs.answer: The course fee covers the training, not a subscription. Express has a free tier that covers a good deal of the day, and paid plans add brand kits with more control, template locking, scheduling, larger generative credit allowances and premium assets. We send a note with the joining instructions explaining which exercises need a paid plan so you can decide before the class rather than during it.

faqs.question: I already use Canva. Is there a reason to switch?
faqs.answer: This course does not argue the case for you. The practical differences worth knowing are that Express is inside the Adobe account and Creative Cloud Libraries you may already pay for, it opens Photoshop and Illustrator files with layers intact, it uses Firefly for generative work with Content Credentials attached, and it has an Adobe Certified Professional exam behind it. If your designers work in Creative Cloud and your marketers do not, that handover is where Express earns its place.

faqs.question: Do you issue a certificate?
faqs.answer: Yes. You receive a MyLearnPlus certificate of completion recording the course title, the hours and the date. It is a record of training, not an Adobe credential. The Adobe Certified Professional in Adobe Express certification is a separate exam sat with Certiport, and the voucher is bought separately.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss the class?
faqs.answer: The session is recorded and available to you for twelve months, and the exercise files are supplied, so you can work through the parts you missed. If you would rather sit it live again, every live booking includes one free repeat of the same class, with the terms shown on the booking page for each date.

faqs.question: Can you run this for our whole team on our own brand?
faqs.answer: Yes, and it is the better option for most teams. In a private class the exercises use your logos, colours, fonts and real campaign material, so you finish the day with your actual brand kit and locked templates built and shared, rather than a practice set. We run private classes live online or at your office, and can split a large team across two dates.

faqs.question: Can my employer be invoiced?
faqs.answer: Yes. We invoice organisations against a purchase order, in LKR for Sri Lankan companies and in USD internationally. Send the billing details and the names of the people attending and we will hold the seats while the invoice is processed.
